svg.aria-label: A rule written in QSL, either in a .native file or in a fenced block inside a Markdown spec, is compiled against a domain model into a checked package, then evaluated against data. The result is one of: holds, violated, refused, unsupported or incomplete.
svg.title: A rule written in QSL, either in a .native file or in a fenced block inside a Markdown spec, is compiled against a domain model into a checked package, then evaluated against data. The result is one of: holds, violated, refused, unsupported or incomplete.
